summary: Tested the fix for recipe images not showing in Planner/D-Planner pages due to SerpAPI 429 rate limit errors. Backend API tests confirm /api/recipe-image/fast endpoint properly catches SerpAPI exceptions and falls back to AI generation. Server-side rate limiting (500ms minimum between calls) prevents 429 errors. Frontend stagger delay (500-2500ms) reduces concurrent requests. UI test confirmed 21 recipe images loaded successfully in the weekly planner.

Sequential requests succeed with rate limiting
Concurrent requests (5 parallel) handled gracefully - no 500 errors
Graceful handling when no images found (returns source='none' or AI fallback)
Empty recipe name handled without crash
Batch loading test: 7/7 weekly meals returned images
UI: 21 meal images loaded successfully in weekly planner
